evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Mary Owen), moving date (16th October), route (Wylie Texas to Lufkin Texas), size (single story ranch, 3 bed/2 bath) — all four covered.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Jevic correctly identified move as 'large move already for... more than 1600 square footage' and routed to large move specialist callback rather than continuing with pricing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly into profile-building and property details without first asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details: Gathered: property type (ranch), stories/bedrooms (single story, 3 bed/2 bath at origin; 3 bed/2.5 bath + in-law suite at destination), some room details (dining room set, antique furniture, entertainment centers). Not gathered: walking distance to truck, additional rooms, specific special considerations beyond furniture list, explicit count of rooms/items. Partial coverage.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: N/A — walkthrough scheduler call, routing to specialist callback.

top_strength: Jevic correctly identified and routed a large-move intake (1,600+ sq ft) to a specialist callback rather than attempting to price on the call, and confirmed callback logistics (phone number, timeframe) cleanly.
coaching_note: Before routing to a specialist on large moves, ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' to surface the customer's agenda — this intelligence feeds the specialist and improves handoff quality.
